conviction_note: Findings net to a small positive (+0.4: a Fed hike that lifts floating-rate asset yields and software comparables that did not repeat Q1's multiple markdown, against costlier 8% refinancing, sector credit stress and a CFO exit). The scaled number is -0.5 (p_up 45 x abs 5.0) because this name has risen after 1 of its last 7 prints, the BDC tape fell ~3% into the print, and the NII bar is disputed. That gap is the reaction function overruling weak macro-proxy positives, and I have not tidied it away.
bar: Adjusted NII $0.47/share and revenue $31.51M per Earnings Whispers (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/SAR, page for the 2026-10-06 report). It disagrees with a Benzinga-sourced $0.55 Q2 FY27 consensus seen only in a search snippet (https://jp.benzinga.com/quote/SAR/earnings-forecasts, 403 on fetch), so the bar is DISPUTED and every finding is capped small. Q1 actual was $0.47 adj. NII against a $0.54 Zacks consensus (https://wtop.com/news/2026/07/saratoga-investment-fiscal-q1-earnings-snapshot/). There is no sourced NAV consensus. The last reported NAV is $23.23 at 2026-05-31 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001377936/000121390026075941/ea029727501ex99-1.htm).
positioning_check: MarketBeat, settlement 2026-09-15: 690,893 shares short, 4.81% of float, 4.1 days to cover, down 7.1% m/m (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/SAR/short-interest). Not a crowded short. No usable option chain: skew is null and put/call OI is 1.58 on only 170 contracts total. Tape: spot $16.00 at the 52-week low, -6.05% over 5d, -8.31% over 20d, about 0.69x the last NAV. Since the 2026-07-07 print it has fallen from $21.42 (company's own 07-06 reference) to $16. Sector: BDCs fell ~3% in the first week of October (https://www.itiger.com/hant/news/2568436504).

findings.finding: The FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 and the SEP median shows one more hike. Overnight SOFR went from ~3.63% through Jun-Aug to 3.90% by late September. 98.8% of SAR's debt investments are floating rate (10-K), and its liabilities are mostly fixed-rate notes and SBIC debentures. So forward NII guidance on the 10-07 call gets a base-rate tailwind of roughly +$0.03/share/quarter (my arithmetic: ~$950M floating x 25bp, net of incentive fee, over 16.3M shares). This comes after a year in which falling base rates were management's stated cause of the NII decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior hike-cycle print in the 7-event baseline. The last prints were driven by NII misses tied to falling base rates and tighter spreads (Q1 FY27 -14.09%).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were pricing a forward NII tailwind, BDCs would not have fallen ~3% in the first week of October and SAR would not sit at a 52-week low with an ~18.75% yield on a $0.75 quarterly dividend. Instead the sector tape is trading credit fear, not rate carry. The Q2 quarter itself (ended 08-31) carries none of the hike, so it shows up only on the call.
findings.independence: SOFR series https://www.sofrrate.com/sofr-rate/2026-09 (3.62% to 3.90% in September); monthly averages https://www.global-rates.com/en/interest-rates/sofr/historical/2026/; floating share from the 10-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001377936/000121390026052176/ea0283348-10k_saratoga.htm. This is a proxy: macro-to-company transmission that the company has not yet confirmed.

findings.finding: SAR redeemed its 6% notes due 2027 with $85M of 8% notes due 2031 (issued 2026-08-26), $12.75M of over-allotment (09-02) and a further $20.08M add-on at 8% (priced 09-23). That is ~$118M at 8% replacing 6% paper, about -$0.03/share/quarter of NII from Q3, on top of the higher-cost refinancing management already flagged on the Q1 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 call flagged the higher cost of refinanced bonds as an NII drag, and that print fell -14.09%. The individual effect of this line is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, because the offerings were public 8-Ks. What is not yet visible is the run-rate NII effect: the new notes started accruing late in Q2 and the add-on is new money at 8% that must be deployed. If it were fully priced, the Q3 NII consensus would be below Q2, and I could not source one.
findings.independence: Add-on terms: https://finviz.com/news/394897/saratoga-investment-corp-prices-public-offering-of-additional-2008-million-800-notes-due-2031. On what the money buys: it refinances a 2027 maturity and extends it to 2031 with a BBB private rating, so it is not distress. The negative is only the coupon step-up, which is partly offset by finding 1 (a separate fact).

findings.finding: In the Q1 FY27 release (quarter to 2026-05-31), $6.0M (33%) of the NAV markdown was a 'broad market adjustment to comparable market multiples' on equity positions. Over SAR's Q2 (Jun-Aug) the software comparable set recovered: IGV was $101.64 at May-end and $109.98 at August-end on one series (another gives $101.91), after a late-June dip. So the largest non-credit driver of last quarter's -$1.19 NAV decline did not repeat at the 08-31 mark date and may partly reverse.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 FY27 NAV fell 4.9% (-$1.19), with $0.93 of it unrealized depreciation, and the stock fell -14.09% on the print.
findings.why_not_priced: At $16 the stock is about 0.69x the $23.23 May NAV, below the sector's ~0.8x average discount (Octus). So the price already implies a further material NAV cut. If the market had priced a stable 08-31 mark from a comps rebound, the stock would not have kept falling from ~$18.4 after the July print to a new low.
findings.independence: IGV monthly prices: https://www.digrin.com/stocks/detail/IGV/price. The comparable-multiple channel comes from SAR's own release, but how the comps move into SAR's private marks is inference. The credit-specific names (Exigo on red watch, Chronus) can still be marked down; this finding covers only the multiple leg.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-09 the board declared the Q3 FY27 dividend at $0.75 ($0.25 monthly, Sep/Oct/Nov), so a dividend cut cannot be announced at this print. Management also cited ~five quarters of spillover on the Q1 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The sweep reports a July print with a dividend reduction, but the company documents show a $0.75 quarterly base held through Q2 and Q3 FY27. The -14.09% July move came alongside an NII miss.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. The stock was $17.64 on the 09-04 reference and fell ~9% after the declaration, so the market does not believe the run-rate. This is sized near zero, and only because the most-feared line is off the table for this print.
findings.independence: Q1 call spillover comment: https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/SAR/Q12027. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: BDC credit stress is rising across the sector. KBRA puts the median non-accrual at 2.75% of cost at 2Q26 (from 1.81%), and BDCs fell ~3% in the first week of October. SAR's own Q1 non-accruals were 0.0% of fair value and 1.2% of cost, below that median, but the sector tape sets the reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has risen after 1 of its last 7 prints (baseline), all during a falling-rate, stressed-credit tape.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the stock is at its low. The residual is that SAR's 08-31 quarter end comes after the June-quarter peer prints, so any new non-accrual adds to an already-negative tape rather than surprising it.
findings.independence: Sector tape: https://www.itiger.com/hant/news/2568436504. This is a proxy, and SAR's own non-accrual figure argues against transmission, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: CFO Henri Steenkamp is stepping down effective 2026-10-31 for health reasons. The Chief Accounting Officer becomes principal financial officer, and Steenkamp stays on the board and as CFO of the SBIC subsidiaries. This is his last print as CFO.
findings.why_not_priced: It was public on 09-18 and is largely priced. The residual is that the call is the first chance for questions on succession, and the change comes in a stressed quarter for marks.
findings.independence: EDGAR 8-K item 5.02 filed 2026-09-18 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001377936&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40). Same event, so this is not independent evidence.

searched_and_found_nothing: Insider buying at 0.69x NAV: the only Form 4s since July (07-23, 08-19, 09-10) are CEO gifts and dispositions, with no open-market purchase found (quantisnow).
Public credit events at named watch-list borrowers (Pepper Palace already written to zero; Exigo; Chronus): none found beyond the company's own Q1 commentary.
Realized gains or exits during Jun-Aug 2026: none announced.
Interest-rate sensitivity table in the FY26 10-K Item 7A: could not be reached in the fetched text, so the +25bp effect is my own estimate.
Option chain: unusable (no two-sided ATM), so there is no implied move or skew.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (rate hike, comps rebound) against a baseline that is all negative: 52-week low, -8.3% over 20 days, 1 of 7 prints up, sector falling. With no skew to read, I let the reaction history carry p_up below 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (macro-to-company proxy): Fed-hike finding cut from +0.6 to +0.4; sector-credit-stress finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2, because SAR's own non-accruals sit below the sector median.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the refinancing buys a 2026-27 maturity extension at BBB, not distress, so the negative is only the coupon step-up; cut from -0.4 to -0.3.
Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the dividend finding's own why_not_priced says the market fell 9% after the declaration, so it was cut from +0.2 to +0.1.

Rule 2 (software comps / NAV): the comps finding stays +0.6 to +0.5. It rests on a company-document channel (the Q1 release names the multiple adjustment), so only a small trim for the inference step.
Rule 6 (disputed bar): the bar is disputed ($0.47 against $0.55), so all sizes stay small. They already were, and nothing else changed.
Rule 1 (reaction function): p_up stays at 45 and abs_move_pct at 5.0. The scaled number is unchanged at -0.5.
